hooks.name: test-companion
hooks.description: When the agent creates a new pure-logic module, asks it to create the matching example and property test files.

action.prompt: You just created a new pure-logic module. If it has no tests yet, create <name>.test.ts for example tests and, if any spec property applies to it, <name>.pbt.test.ts using fast-check. Name each property and the requirement it validates in a comment, as described in .kiro/steering/structure.md. Don't create tests for browser adapters (*-adapter.ts).
